question: A legal analyst wants Claude to reference a set of contract templates in every chat within a 'Contracts Review' project without re-uploading them each time. What is the correct way to make these templates persistently available across all chats in that project?
options: A) Upload the contract templates once to the project's knowledge base so all chats can reference them
B) Paste the full text of every contract template directly into the project instructions field
C) Email the templates to Claude support so an agent can manually link them to the analyst's account
D) Attach the templates only to the first chat and mark that chat as the project's default conversation
correct_answers: A) Upload the contract templates once to the project's knowledge base so all chats can reference them
explanations: Correct. Files added to the project knowledge base are available as context across all chats within the project, avoiding repeated uploads.
Incorrect. Project instructions are meant for behavioral guidance like tone and role, not for storing full reference documents; the knowledge base is the appropriate location for that.
Incorrect. There is no support workflow for linking documents to an account this way; uploads go directly into the project's knowledge base.
Incorrect. Attachments made within an individual chat are not automatically shared with other chats; only knowledge base uploads persist project-wide.
